paragraphs: Charsum. R' Elazar ben Charsum, the High Priest.

notes.text: כה״ג is read as כהן גדול, “the High Priest,” in this context. The separate “see his entry” instruction is retained without inventing a destination label. The abbreviated personal title remains R'.
